purpose: Teach: 環境庁/窒素/憲章/圧勝/疑念/塩素/至福/皇族

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、環境庁通報をめぐる事案を、警察、扱われてますね
lines.en: So this case involving the environmental agency report — the police are handling it, aren't they?
lines.style: Careful, measured inquiry. Ren leans slightly forward, genuinely curious. Soft pause before the question particle, inviting confirmation rather than demanding it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、工場の窒素酸化物漏出を厳しく取り締まります
lines.en: The police are cracking down hard on the factory's nitrogen oxide leak.
lines.style: Direct, official tone. Takeda speaks with steady conviction. Even pacing, matter-of-fact delivery. No elaboration—just stating what will happen.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察憲章の改訂を、警察、検討されてますね
lines.en: And regarding this case, the police are considering revisions to the police charter, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful probe. Ren's voice stays level and genuine. He's testing understanding, not confronting. Slight emphasis on 'considering'—genuine respect for process.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、選挙圧勝後の不正捜査を進めます
lines.en: The police are advancing the investigation into fraudulent activities following the election landslide.
lines.style: Steady, procedural. Takeda remains composed and professional. Clear syllables, no inflection beyond clarity. Speaking as institutional will, not personal opinion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、市民の疑念を、警察、丁寧に解消されますね
lines.en: In this case, I trust the police will address citizens' concerns carefully and thoroughly, won't they?
lines.style: Respectful but slightly tentative. Ren's tone carries genuine hope beneath a careful question. He's not demanding—he's expressing faith while gently holding the police accountable.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、毒物塩素を用いた事件を捜査します
lines.en: The police are investigating the incident involving toxic chlorine.
lines.style: Factual delivery, slightly heavier weight. Takeda's voice carries the gravity of the substance involved. Steady pace, no rush—this is serious work stated plainly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者ご家族の至福を奪う事件、警察、許しませんね
lines.en: This case—the way it robbed the victim's family of their peace—the police won't tolerate that, will they?
lines.style: Deeper conviction now. Ren's voice carries quiet moral weight. He slows slightly on 'robbed the victim's family,' then firms up on the assertion. This is personal principle stated professionally.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、皇族警備の体制を強化しております
lines.en: We are currently strengthening the security framework for the imperial family.
lines.style: Formal, measured, almost ceremonial. Takeda shifts slightly more official—this is state-level work. Calm authority. No apology, no hesitation.
